freeze_timing: Before any C39 quality result or C13 paired confirmation outcome; correction of a discovered complete-parent implementation mismatch.

comparisons.P01: Actual stock baseline with the already tested formate compatibility repair; existing reference-masked C41 core output.
comparisons.P16: P01 followed by the exact frozen production measured-reference overlay, with validation-only reference exclusions.
comparisons.cpu_and_gpu: The same frozen new heads applied to P16, matching the production order.
comparisons.P14: Original frozen P14 control on the same P01 core and complete query panel; do not add a new overlay to this historical negative control.

C39_reference_exclusion: For the additional measured-reference library, exclude official query identities, same formulas, same nonempty Murcko scaffolds, Morgan2 Tanimoto >= 0.70 to any frozen C39 query, unparseable identities, and query-acquisition signature aliases. Preserve retained metadata/peak alignment and original order. Do not change production reference data. Also preserve the existing global raw/official identity-alias quarantine derived from the original reference witnesses.

admission_before_C13.complete_cpu_and_gpu_vs_P01: Each must have strictly positive development192 exact MRR delta and nonnegative exact deltas for every source and actual query mode.
admission_before_C13.incremental_cpu_and_gpu_vs_P16: Each selected head must separately pass the same criteria versus its own selected parent (P01 or P16); the parent overlay cannot qualify a harmful head.

head_invariants_relative_to_P16.scope: Relative to the selected own parent, P01 or P16.

admission_before_C13.complete_changes_relative_to_P01: Must exactly equal the frozen P16 overlay followed by the frozen head. P16 can promote rank1 or insert a reference candidate by its existing policy. Report every recovered/displaced truth and every rank1/membership change; do not incorrectly assert zero for the full composite.

C13.prerequisite: Both full candidates and both incremental heads pass all C39 gates and full production-source/artifact checks.
C13.reference_exclusion: Use the complete original C13 candidate-source identity inventory for official-identity exclusion, conservatively exclude unparseable identities and query-input spectral aliases, without opening the reserved per-query labels. Near-chemistry exposure remains reported, as in the original C13 protocol.
C13.complete_candidate_vs_P01: Each exact point delta must be nonnegative for all120, positive60 and negative60.
C13.incremental_head_vs_P16: Each selected head must have nonnegative exact point delta versus its own selected parent for all120 and positive60; all60 negative queries retain that own parent exactly.
C13.instrument_limitation: C13 is single-acquisition FT/HCD source stress; it is not a replacement for target timsTOF evidence.

qualification_tier: Exploratory fixed pair, not statistical promotion or established leaderboard calibration. Only actual public scores establish improvement.

selection_before_source_outcomes.data: Only the frozen development192 queries. Do not match source predictions to truth until both choices are sealed.
selection_before_source_outcomes.eligibility: Strictly positive exact development MRR delta versus P01 AND versus the candidate own parent.
selection_before_source_outcomes.rule: For each head, choose the eligible parent giving the highest exact development complete-candidate MRR. Exact ties prefer P01. No eligible variant means no selected entry.
selection_before_source_outcomes.after_selection: Freeze both complete-source notebook pins and chosen predictions before held-out-source metrics. Reject a failing source choice; do not switch to the other parent using source outcomes.

parent_ablation_amendment_before_outcome.reason: Causal parent ablation after discovering that P16 promotes rank1 and inserts candidates. All four complete pipelines are frozen before any development/source outcome; only development may choose between them. Two scoring entries maximum.

lossless_reference_preselection.rule: Before chemistry parsing, discard references outside the exact union of the original fixed P16 precursor windows for all query acquisitions (10ppm +0.002Da, inclusive bounds). The production matcher cannot access those rows. Preserve original order of reachable rows. Verify unmasked real30 final-list parity independently.
